create_host_kv_cache: create a HostKVCache subclass to allocate host memory for hierarchical KV cache with configurable page size and layout
build_mha_token_pool_host: build an MHATokenToKVPoolHost instance to manage host-side MHA KV cache buffers with layer-first or page-first layout
build_mla_token_pool_host: build an MLATokenToKVPoolHost instance to manage host-side MLA KV cache buffers with configurable kv_cache_dim override
build_mamba_pool_host: build a MambaPoolHost instance to manage host-side Mamba conv and temporal state buffers for hybrid cache
transfer_kv_to_device: transfer KV cache data from host to device per layer using kernel, direct, or kernel_ascend io_backend
